Container.Name: Unraid Template Sync
Container.Overview: Receives authenticated GitHub push webhooks and automatically refreshes this Unraid server's private Community Applications XML templates.
Container.Description:
Secure webhook receiver for the Lowess Unraid template catalog.
It validates GitHub's HMAC-SHA256 signature, repository, branch, and delivery ID before cloning or fetching the configured public repository over HTTPS. It then force-resets the managed checkout and mirrors Lowess/*.xml to Community Applications private templates. A startup sync recovers changes missed while the container was stopped.
Put this service behind an HTTPS Nginx Proxy Manager host, restrict NPM to the current GitHub webhook CIDRs from https://api.github.com/meta, and use the same high-entropy webhook secret in this template and GitHub. IP allowlisting is intentionally handled by NPM, not the application. See the project README for setup details.
Container.Changes:
###v1.2.0 (2026-09-22) - Clone the public template repository automatically when the managed checkout is empty. - Refuse to overwrite non-Git files during first-start bootstrap. - No GitHub PAT or host SSH credentials are required.
###v1.1.0 (2026-09-22) - Moved the Go service and GHCR build to the dedicated Lowess/unraid-template-sync project. - Moved GitHub webhook IP allowlisting exclusively to Nginx Proxy Manager. - Removed the application state mount and proxy/IP enforcement settings.
###v1.0.0 (2026-09-21) - Initial release with HMAC, repository, branch, delivery replay, and GitHub source-IP validation. - Added asynchronous webhook handling, startup reconciliation, and health reporting.

Config.Name: Managed template repository
Config.Description: Managed docker-templates-unraid checkout. The service clones it automatically when this directory is empty; tracked changes and, when enabled, untracked files are discarded during sync.

Config.Name: Private template destination
Config.Description: Destination for the mirrored Lowess XML templates. Stale XML files are deleted; non-XML files are left untouched.

Config.Name: Webhook HTTP port
Config.Description: HTTP port consumed by Nginx Proxy Manager. Do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: GitHub Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Required high-entropy secret shared with the GitHub repository webhook. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: GitHub Repository
Config.Description: Only webhook payloads for this exact owner/repository are accepted.

Config.Name: GitHub Branch
Config.Description: Only pushes to this branch start a sync.

Config.Name: Git HTTPS URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS Git URL used for fetches; no host SSH keys are mounted.

Config.Name: Clean untracked repository files
Config.Description: Run git clean -fd after reset, matching the previous script. Disable only if this checkout intentionally contains untracked files.

Config.Name: Sync on container start
Config.Description: Reconcile templates at startup to recover from missed webhook deliveries.
